# `deform.displace`: Displace

Moves vertices along their normals by seeded fractal noise (bumps, rocks, terrain, organic variation).

- Category: deform
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(F + C) for normals plus O(k x octaves) for k vertices
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: displace, noise, displacement modifier, randomize vertices, polyNoise

Each vertex moves along its normal by up to `strength` times smooth 3D noise with features about `scale` in size; `octaves` adds finer layers. The same seed always gives the same result. Needs a reasonably dense mesh (subdivide or use `prim.ico_sphere` / segmented primitives first).

**Use for** rocks (ico sphere, strength 10 to 20% of the size), terrain, dents and organic irregularity. Follow with `edit.smooth` if it looks noisy.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `octaves` | `number` | `3` | Noise layers (1 to 8): more adds finer detail. |
| `scale` | `Length` | `0.1` | Size of the bumps. |
| `seed` | `number \| null` | - | Noise seed: the same seed gives the same shape. The call's seed when omitted. |
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Vertices to displace (edges and faces select theirs); all when omitted. |
| `strength` | `Length` | `0.01` | Largest offset along the normals. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"scale":"50cm","seed":7,"strength":"5cm","target":"tiles"}
```

Result: `tiles (o:6): displaced 25 vertices by up to 50 mm (scale 0.5 m, seed 7)`
